sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is closest to A. obeuntis and A. perelegans; compared with the former it is smaller and has 1—2 fewer antennal segments, and compared with the latter it is larger, paler and has 1 fewer antennal segment. The soldier is closest to A. laurensis, from which it differs in the 13-segmented antennae.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Small pale brown species, compound eyes rather large, ocelli and fontanelle both large, postclypeus yellow. Head, thorax and abdomen covered with fairly dense long yellow hairs. Ocelli very large, almost as wide as long, close to the compound eye. Fontanelle broadly oval, with a linear prolongation. Postclypeus a little more than half as long as wide. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 very small; segment 5 larger than segment 4; segment 14 about as long as segment 13, the apex pointed. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, the anterior margin nearly straight, the anterior corners rounded, the posterior margin broad and slightly concave. Posterior margins of meso- and metanotum broad and moderately deeply notched. Radial vein of both wings nearly obsolete; media of the forewing with 2 or 3 branches; cubitus running through the middle of the wing, with 9—11 branches. Measurements: length with wings 10.50—11.00 mm, length without wings 5.50—6.25 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.10—1.17 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.56—0.66 mm, head width 1.00—1.08 mm, greatest diameter of compound eye 0.29—0.31 mm, ocellus length 0.14 mm, pronotum length 0.47—0.51 mm, width 0.84—0.88 mm, forewing length 8.50 mm, width 2.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Closest to A. laurensis, from which it differs, among other characters, in the 13-segmented antennae. Length and width of antennal segment 2 only slightly greater than those of segment 3; segment 4 distinctly longer than segment 2. Measurements: total length 4.50—5.00 mm, head length (mandibles crossed at the tooth, including mandibles) 1.87 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 1.21—1.32 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.65—1.75 mm, head width 1.13—1.17 mm, pronotum length 0.36 mm, width 0.73 mm.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), originally in English; the original describes the alate and the soldier, the worker being represented only by "a few worker series tentatively referred to this species" without morphological description, so no worker section is given. OCR problems: the postclypeus measurement "(0.29 x 0,4?)" has a damaged final digit, so only the verbal description is retained; "3rd segment very snail" should be small; "hall" is half; "Pig." is an error for Fig.; "sth" is an error for 5th. Distribution and biology are not translated into the morphology section.
